title: Matching Rules for a Three-Dimensional Strongly Aperiodic Monotile
summary: A recent pre-print [arXiv:2609.19214] proposed a three-dimensional (3D) strongly aperiodic monotile: a shape that tiles Euclidean space only non-periodically and which admits no symmetry of infinite order. The proof takes the 3D Chair tile identified previously by Lee and Moody, and adds geometric decorations to the faces so as to force non-periodicity (without these decorations The Chair also admits periodic tilings).
